title: Peter R NDE 159
content:
The negative experiences (3) occurred in mid '87 and within a 3 month period. Number 1: I had been living hard, and strained my heart to such a degree that it finally gave out. I felt difficulty breathing, and lay on the floor of my flat. I then felt an incredible pain, the like of which I had never experienced before. It was so severe; I reached for a knife to kill myself to get away from the pain. It felt like a steel band was tightened around my chest to such an extent, that I was crushed. I thought of crawling downstairs to a young girl that lived there to get help, but I KNEW I would not make it, and if somehow I did, I would die in front of her. I considered the effect my gruesome death would have on her, and [she was 21] thought it best to stay where I was and let nature take its course. I had wet myself, and my nose and eyes were running. I then felt a curious detachment to what was happening, and I lost ALL sensation in my physical body. My hearing CEASED TO BE, and I could no longer move or focus my eyes, but I could still see. Then I was outside my body. I don't know how, I was just outside it. I was standing up, and there was a spirit waiting for me. I glanced behind me, and I saw a body lying on the floor. I was about to say to the spirit; hold on, there's someone on the floor… but the thought came out like a shout, and I realized that the body was me. I turned back to the Spirit realizing that I had died. The Spirit said [by thought] 'It was your fault that you died, because you were not looking after yourself. That is considered a form of suicide, and there is a penalty that must be paid.' A screen appeared far in front of me, depicting the negative aspects of my character in HUMAN FORMS. They became animated and started to attack me. I was kicked and punched. I felt the pain of each contact. Curiously, I felt no need to defend myself or fight off my attackers. They then moved backwards as though they were on rewind and got back onto the screen as they were before they animated. The Spirit then communicated: 'YOU HAVE NO RIGHT TO HURT YOURSELF OR ANYONE ELSE, BECAUSE YOU AND EVERYONE ELSE ARE THE PERSONAL PROPERTY OF GOD' All this took place in a black void. There was nothing there. All negative aspects of my nature were magnified far more than what they are here in the physical realm. There was/is NO ESCAPING FROM MYSELF. I was then somehow put back in my body, and gradually began to pull myself together. It was not until many years later that I realized that I was given another chance to continue because I had put a young girl's welfare ahead of my own, even though I was dying. Number 2: My heart and lungs gave out again and I went through very much the same physical reactions as the first experience. I knew I was going into that black void again, and I prayed. I won't ask for mercy or anything like that, all I have to say is that I am not FULLY RESPONSIBLE for the mental and emotional state that I am in. That was enough to allow the dying process to be reversed. Number 3: Heart/lung failure again. I went into the black void. I was in a hell of my own making. I was emotionally and mentally (?) 'damned'. I had no choice but to face up to myself and knew I was doomed to stay where I was until I did, and made an effort to get my thinking and living straight. All the experiences had a timelessness about them, and if 2 seconds pass here in the physical, an 'eternity' is there. I hope I have made myself reasonably clear. I cannot prove what I experienced, as it always remains subjective for the experiencer. Even if I could prove with medical records all illnesses, it still won't prove the actual out of body experiences. I know this will be of help to some people out there. We all go somewhere after leaving the physical.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported being "outside my body" and "standing up," then glancing behind and seeing his body lying on the floor.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He described detachment and loss of bodily sensation and hearing before being outside the body.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "spirit" waiting for him; later referred to as "The Spirit" communicating by thought.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "black void" where "There was nothing there"; a "screen" appeared far in front depicting negative aspects of his character in human forms.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He later interpreted that he was given another chance because he put a young girl's welfare ahead of his own while dying.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart and lung failure/heart strain (three episodes within ~3 months in mid 1987).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Distressing/hellish void with attack by "negative aspects" shown on a screen; prayer in second episode; "hell of my own making" in third.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE into a black void with an encountered spirit and a screen-based negative character display/attack; no tunnel/light/loved ones; return occurred without a described boundary.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Three episodes involved going into the "black void"; first included OBE and spirit encounter; second involved prayer to reverse the process; third described being "damned" in the void.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A screen appeared depicting the negative aspects of his character in human forms; they animated and attacked him, then rewound back onto the screen.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'It was your fault that you died, because you were not looking after yourself. That is considered a form of suicide, and there is a penalty that must be paid.'; 'YOU HAVE NO RIGHT TO HURT YOURSELF OR ANYONE ELSE, BECAUSE YOU AND EVERYONE ELSE ARE THE PERSONAL PROPERTY OF GOD'; 'There was/is NO ESCAPING FROM MYSELF.'; 'if 2 seconds pass here in the physical, an "eternity" is there.'
